de'longhi - la specialista touch espress.name: De'Longhi - La Specialista Touch Espresso Machine with Cold Brew & Automatic Frothing - Stainless Steel
de'longhi - la specialista touch espress.description: The La Specialista Touch semi-automatic espresso machine grinds, doses, brews, and froths your favorite coffee drinks at home while offering real-time guidance so you can enjoy hands-on espresso making with confidence. Enjoy a seamless, interactive experience with the large 3.5-inch high-resolution touch display to select from 10 preset recipes, follow step-by-step expert instructions and craft and save your own custom coffee creations. Explore different bean varieties with ease thanks to the intelligent Bean Adapt Technology, ensuring optimal extraction. Simply follow the on-screen interactive guide to set the ideal grind, dose level, pre-infusion and brewing temperature of your hot or cold coffee drink based on your choice of beans. With La Specialista Touch, ultimate customization is at your fingertips. With 4 user profiles, 6 saved bean profiles, 10 preset drink recipes, 4 pre-infusion temperatures, 4 milk temperature settings, and 5 froth levels, the possibilities are endless when it comes to crafting & personalizing your favorite drinks at home - including lattes, iced lattes, cappuccinos, flat whites, espresso martinis, cold brew and more. The 15-setting Italian-made burr grinder precisely finds the perfect grind for any bean variety in a single or double dose. The automatic milk frother adjusts between 5 froth levels and 4 temperature settings based on your drink selection and choice of dairy or plant-based milk, and Cold Extraction Technology auto-adjusts the machine’s settings to create refreshing cold brew recipes in under 5 minutes. Perfect your brew with ease thanks to the comprehensive toolkit, including an advanced precision tamper to achieve the perfect dose up to 20g for a clean and enhanced experience. This kit comes fully equipped with a portafilter, two single-wall filter baskets, dosing & tamping guide, tamping mat, and stainless steel milk jug. With La Specialista Touch, hands-on coffee-crafting and interactive guidance unite to guide you through every step of crafting your perfect cup.
